title: Grateful Dead Live at The Warehouse on 1970-02-01
lineage: SBD > Bill Gadsen Reels > C > DAT > WAV > SHN

ai_review.summary: A historically significant show captured in decent‑sounding audio, highlighted by an epic, extended Lovelight featuring guest rap.
ai_review.review: The recording offers a solid listening experience of a memorable concert that fans recall for its historic context and the unusually long Lovelight jam. Reviewers praise the performance—especially the extended Lovelight with a surprise vocalist—and note the sound is clear enough to enjoy despite lacking detailed source information.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are positive (4–5 stars) and consistently mention a great performance and good sound quality, yielding an overall rating above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the clip as having "good sound" and being "excellent", though no specifics about board vs. audience are given.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is noted for its historic significance and a particularly long, jam‑heavy Lovelight that dominates the memory of listeners.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar tone is praised and contrasted with guest guitarist Peter Green’s quieter amp.
